text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at a steep loss was painful, but I should decide whether to hold based on its prospects and my plan—not just wait for it to return to my average cost.","I sold Stock E for a gain and later bought it back at a higher price; before selling or rebuying, I should consider the whole decision rather than focus only on locking in a gain.","My account can rise or fall even when I make no trades, so I should review whether my overall holdings still suit my needs without reacting to every monthly move."]}
